Ep 101 is built from DBZ 202B-203 footage (Kanzenshuu marks both DBZ 202 and 203 'Filler Episode'), so it carries the reader position at 424 with continue point 425. Ep 165 is built from DBZ 287B-288 (287's manga half is 517 p.1-10, already in our ep 164; 287B is its filler half; 288 is a full filler episode) — the hypothesised ch 517 tail is NOT in ep 165: Kanzenshuu maps 517 p.11-end to DBZ 289, whose footage Wikipedia places in our ep 166, so the stored 164 (ends 517 p.10) and 166 (starts 517 p.11) anchors stand unchanged.
